reviewed_scope.blind_sheet_scope: all 30 choices across nine exact full-decoded-source-render sheets
risk_coverage: high-key sky above deep forest shadows
dense foliage and bright reflective surfaces
architecture edges and smooth cloud gradients
bright cloud detail above dark landscape
inverted geometry, fine plant structure and source clipping

findings: No candidate-generated geometry failure, seam, colour block, red-speckle field, posterization or unstable texture was confirmed.
High-key clipping in the DJI, OM System, Samsung and Google rows is already present under fixed AO6 and the source boundary; the automatic new-boundary metric is exactly zero for every arm.
Architecture edges, cloud gradients, foliage and the inverted plant geometry remain spatially coherent in the adaptive arm.
The adaptive arm is frequently less photographically appealing than fixed AO6, but this preference failure is not relabelled as a severe artifact.
claim_ceiling: risk-based autonomous full-resolution severe-artifact review on the frozen BN7 population; not universal safety, population preference, film truth or product promotion
